title: wrong order for awscli region value ?

labels.name: 🌱 good first issue
labels.description: Good first issue to get your feet wet.

body:
#### Current Behavior
<!-- A clear and concise description of the behavior. -->
It seems current starship make env var `AWS_DEFAULT_REGION` overrides `AWS_REGION`, https://github.com/starship/starship/blob/master/src/modules/aws.rs#L70

#### Expected Behavior
<!-- A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen. -->
but according to the [aws official doc](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-envvars.html)

```markdown
[AWS_DEFAULT_REGION](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-quickstart.html#cli-configure-quickstart-region)
Specifies the AWS Region to send the request to.

If defined, this environment variable overrides the value for the profile setting region and . You can override this environment variable by using the --region command line parameter and the AWS SDK compatible AWS_REGION environment variable.
```

the correct behavior should be the opposite. 

#### Additional context/Screenshots
<!-- Add any other context about the problem here. If applicable, add screenshots to help explain. -->
